policy: Each listed test must run and pass on desktop-chromium-es and may be skipped only on the other projects active in the current Playwright run.

entries.title: persistent accessibility controls reflow at 320px and the PWA caches public assets only
entries.reason: One real Chromium ceremony avoids concurrent preference writes

entries.title: AC-08 browser previews create, update and skip while retaining an accent-insensitive homonym
entries.reason: One deterministic mocked commit avoids persistent roster growth

entries.title: AC-09 restricted committee browser receives redacted members and cannot export
entries.reason: The real restricted Demo identity is exercised once

entries.title: AC-18 browser presents zero-vote, single-candidate, tie, top-K and cutoff-tie outcomes without writes
entries.reason: Deterministic read-only aggregate projections run once

entries.title: AC-20 live browser responses are no-store and the SSE ready frame is metadata-only
entries.reason: One live network inspection is sufficient

entries.title: renders charts and their table alternatives without mutation requests
entries.reason: One read-only browser is sufficient for the persisted aggregate contract

entries.title: custodian creates, restores and revokes an encrypted device backup without browser persistence
entries.reason: One browser ceremony is sufficient; custody writes are synthetic and leave Demo unchanged

entries.title: authorized browser generates valid PDF, XLSX and CSV artifacts locally
entries.reason: One isolated client ceremony validates every downloadable report format

entries.title: large roster inspection and preview stay off the browser main thread
entries.reason: One mandatory browser proves the dedicated-worker boundary

entries.title: member administration edits encrypted data and projects archive/reactivation without Demo writes
entries.reason: One synthetic browser management scenario covers the member lifecycle without changing Demo

entries.title: local catalog extension create, edit, disable and reactivate are projected without Demo writes
entries.reason: One synthetic browser management scenario covers catalog lifecycle without changing Demo

entries.title: authorized Chromium normalizes, encrypts, displays and archives a photo without sending original bytes
entries.reason: One real Chromium execution is sufficient; photo writes are synthetic and leave Demo unchanged

entries.title: offline draft is revalidated against a closed round before submission
entries.reason: Exercises the local demo race once without mutating tenant data

entries.title: tampered candidate ciphertext fails closed in the browser
entries.reason: Exercises one authenticated browser and never persists plaintext or secrets
